request: 工作目录要支持自由配置，现在选不了
acceptance: 从宿主机根目录选择工作目录（受操作系统权限约束）
地址栏可以输入路径并跳转；越界不静默回退
保存后刷新配置与目录列表
scope: 本地 Docker 挂载配置

requirements.summary: 用户要求从 macOS 根目录自由选择。

design.summary: 区分宿主机共享根和活动工作目录；不能将 Docker Linux 根伪装成 macOS 根。

implementation.summary: 路径地址栏、范围提示、保存后刷新；新增 macOS 共享目录组合配置。 Compact picker aligned with parent sheet: 520px width, 34px controls, 30px directory rows; consolidated CSS.

verification.summary: Final full regression PASS (Go race/vet, frontend checks, installer and path mapping tests, docs links). Actual Safari 8097 compact picker verified in prior interaction.

documentation.summary: Current Chinese/English startup, installation, architecture, handover and PRD documents use the same .env configuration. Historical reports retained.

cleanup.summary: Removed both temporary preview containers; preserved their data and unrelated services.

release.summary: Merged main, tagged and pushed v0.1.7.0-RC1; GitHub prerelease published with arm64 image, SHA256SUMS and all 19 verified version tags.

release_authorization: 2026-09-24: user requested completion of main merge, tag and GitHub Release after commit/push.
